text.en:
Section 6 of the Presidential Decree No. 218 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Sec. 6. An alien executive of the regional or area headquarters of a multinational company shall enjoy the
privileges extended to foreigners coming to settle in the Philippines for the first time as provided for under
Section 105(h) of the Tariff and Customs Code, as amended, and Section 190(f) of the Internal Revenue Code,
as amended, including the importation, only once, duty and tax free of one (1) motor vehicle subject to the
condition that said motor vehicle shall be subject to payment of duty and tax upon the sale thereof within the
country. This condition shall be indicated in the certificate of payment to be issued by the Collector of
Customs and in the vehicle registration certificate."

Section 8(d) of Presidential Decree No. 218 is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(d) Any willful violation by the regional or area headquarters of a multinational company of any provisions
of this Decree, or its implementing rules and regulations, or other terms and conditions of its registration, or
any provision of existing laws, shall constitute a sufficient cause for the cancellation of its license or
registration. For this purpose, the Secretary of Trade shall, in consultation with the Director-General of the
National Economic and Development Authority, issue regulations governing the operations of said regional or
area headquarters in the Philippines necessary for the effective implementation of this Decree."

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 22nd day of December, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-three.
